title: Finite extraction for prime-to-ell decomposed etale families
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning that it admits a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $\ell$ be a prime, and let $(u_i:U_i\to X)_{i\in I}$ be a set-indexed family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose that for every $x\in X$ there are $i\in I$ and $z\in U_i$ above $x$ with $[\kappa(z):\kappa(x)]$ finite and prime to $\ell$ [def-weil-residue-field]. There is a finite subset $I_0\subseteq I$ such that the same property holds with $i\in I_0$. The sources $U_i$ need not be quasi-compact or separated.

source.place: Expose II Corollary 2.2.4, printed p. 27, for a prime ell; Proposition 2.2.2 makes the prime-to-ell lifting loci open in the compact constructible topology.
